description: One row per leg of the subcontracting trail behind an Out House operation -- Purchase Order, Subcontracting Order, Subcontracting Receipt. Written by the order itself -- see MasterWorkOrder.set_connections().

fields.description: The Out House operation the work went out on.
fields.label: Opration Name

fields.description: The Purchase Order raised for the operation. Empty on an operation whose work has not gone out yet.
fields.label: Purchase Order

fields.description: The Subcontracting Order made from that Purchase Order.
fields.label: Subcontracting Order

fields.description: The receipt the goods came back on. An order returned in parts has one row per receipt.
fields.label: Subcontracting Receipt

fields.description: What went out to the supplier on this order. Nothing where the operation has not gone out yet, and Pending Qty is then the whole of what it still has to run.
fields.label: Qty Sent

fields.description: Accepted qty on this row's receipt.
fields.label: Completed Qty

fields.description: Rejected qty on this row's receipt -- what the supplier destroyed.
fields.label: Process Loss Qty

fields.description: What the Subcontracting Order still owes: Qty Sent less everything received and rejected against it. The order's figure, so it reads the same on each of its receipt rows.
fields.label: Pending Qty

name: Master Work Order Subcontracting Detail
